newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Tuesday on a lack of fresh leads, traders said.

They said Singapore dealers bought rubber in the afternoon at 45.25 U.S. cents/lb for September shipment fob Palembang. Offer prices were generally stable in other centres with little buying interest.
"Most traders do not want to sell because price levels are very low. In Medan, for instance, traders want to sell at 46.00," said one trader.
Traders said the market lacked fresh leads to boost sentiment.
They said offer prices were quoted at 45.50 fob Medan, 45.375 fob Surabaya, fob 45.00 fob Padang and 44.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
